subject: Geopolitics
title: Alliance Dilemmas
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Alliance Dilemmas.

hook.text: In 1914 Austria-Hungary dragged Germany into war through their alliance. Alliances can trap as much as protect.

buildup.text: Glenn Snyder identified two fears: abandonment (your ally won't help) and entrapment (your ally drags you in).

discovery.text: Tight alliances risk entrapment. Loose alliances risk abandonment. Every alliance walks this tightrope.

twist.text: Taiwan tests the US alliance dilemma. Defend it and risk war with China. Abandon it and lose credibility.

climax.text: Alliance dilemmas explain why commitments stay vague. Ambiguity gives leaders room to decide when the moment comes.

punchline.text: Every alliance is a bet that its costs won't exceed its benefits.

quiz.question: What are the two fears in Glenn Snyder's alliance dilemma?
